claims.text: No KnowMe Flutter source may be copied until the owner-directed MIT destination decision is recorded.
Imported paths must retain copyright attribution and machine-readable source mapping.
Filtering must occur in a fresh disposable clone from a committed revision.
Rewritten hashes require an original-to-filtered commit map rather than an identity claim.
KnowMe generic provider/view/CRUD concepts are adapted into the existing canonical entity_graph_flutter package; FFI and product models remain excluded.
hybrid-mobile-architecture-src remains a reference-only template source.
Riverpod 3 migration requires explicit terminal retry semantics and current notifier APIs.
Dependency updates must be resolved and tested under the declared Flutter/Dart toolchain.
